Right now Monica is:
• Building the dataset and oracle pod for the Infinite Policy-Based RL project at AI@UNC (Hugging Face Datasets)
• Doing macroeconomic and monetary-policy research for UNC's College Fed Challenge team
• Developing iOS apps in Swift with Carolina App Team
• Building a data chatbot with Supabase + n8n
answer.pt:
No momento, Monica está:
• Construindo o dataset e o oracle pod do projeto Infinite Policy-Based RL no AI@UNC (Hugging Face Datasets)
• Fazendo pesquisa macroeconômica e de política monetária para a equipe da College Fed Challenge da UNC
• Desenvolvendo apps iOS em Swift no Carolina App Team
• Construindo um chatbot de dados com Supabase + n8n
